author_generator.normalization: Preserve all odd q; replace unavailable original Crystal primes-utils with shared GMP(25), omit logs/output and record exact q.

timing_contract: Complete finite calls include plan/filtering, pool task preparation, candidate construction, synchronization and GMP work. Pool and Metal initialization, compilation and result comparisons are outside timing and separately recorded. Each method returns an owned ordered classification array.
limitations: One host, uncontrolled temperature and background load; no confidence interval or universal optimum.
GMP probable-prime agreement is not independent primality certification or original-author-backend execution.
The same-resource post-5 parallel baseline separates thread-count gains from filter gains.
No full-search billion extrapolation, NVIDIA runtime claim or GIMPS comparison.

cases.scope: Same odd q and GMP(25). Full CPU/Metal paths include factor-plan preparation, sieving, task preparation, allocation, candidate construction, scheduling, synchronization and GMP screening. Pool/backend initialization, kernel compilation, equality checks and output excluded and first-call costs separately recorded. Parallel post-5 paths use the same worker pools. No original primes-utils or billion full-test claim.
